excerpt.zh: 随着最近重力陷阱的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射重力陷阱。
excerpt.en: Following the recent discovery of Gravity Snares, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.

scope.zh: 获得“重力井”科技时的信息提示（重力陷阱设计与使用）。
scope.en: The information notice when Gravity Wells are researched (the Gravity Snare design).

texts.zh: 随着最近重力陷阱的发现，现在[root.GetAdjective]科研船可以发射重力陷阱。
texts.en: Following the recent discovery of Gravity Snares, [root.GetAdjective] science ships are now able to launch Gravity Snares.

texts.zh:
这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获并将太空兽群转运到我们的生态园里，让它们得以继续繁衍生息。

屠宰分解这些生物可以用来收获其基因物质以进行克隆以及获得其他资源。
texts.en:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna to our Vivarium, where they can continue to reproduce new specimens of their kind.

Culling and dissecting these creatures will allow the harvesting of their Genetic Material for cloning purposes as well as other resources.

texts.zh:
这些非致命抛射体可以安全地捕获以及转运太空兽群用于研究及解剖，从而收获其基因物质和其他资源。

如果我们打算豢养并进一步繁育这些生物，我们需要建立一座生态园。可以通过建造一座博物天枢或是在恒星基地上建造建筑[GetHatcheryPlural]来实现。
texts.en:
These non-lethal projectiles can safely capture and transport Space Fauna for study and dissection, harvesting their Genetic Material and resources.

If we are to keep them alive for further breeding, we will need to establish a Vivarium. We can do this by constructing a Grand Archive or by building [GetHatcheryPlural] at our starbases.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现我们的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the word for our side appears here.

texts.zh:
我们的重力陷阱无法准确地追踪收容虫群天灾。基于其运动模式，我们怀疑这些物种应该是被某种更高级的意识所控制着，不具备真正意义上的独立个体。

尝试将一只该生物收容进生态园会威胁到其他物种甚至整个[this.GetName]。

我们已无限期地暂停了对这些生物的捕获行动。
texts.en:
Our Gravity Snares are unable to properly track and contain the Prethoryn Scourge. Based on their movement patterns, we suspect these beings are being controlled by some form of higher consciousness and are not truly individual entities.

Attempting to contain one of these organisms within a Vivarium would endanger our other specimens and even [this.GetName] as a whole.

We have suspended capture operations for these organisms indefinitely.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

summary.text:
# 重力陷阱 / Gravity Snares

- 分类 Category：银河轶事 C8 stories · DLC：Grand Archive

## 如何开始 How it starts

隐藏事件 grand_archive.105（events/grand_archive_events.txt:71-109）：拥有大档案馆DLC的国家最近研究的科技是“重力井”（tech_gravity_wells）时，创建自动更新的重力陷阱设计，并（猛兽师帝国 30 天后，其他立即）给出 7210；若已和掠袭者（prethoryn）建立联络，30 天后再给 7220（见“逐星虫”故事）。
Hidden 105 fires when Gravity Wells is the last researched tech: creates the Gravity Snare design and shows 7210 (30 days later for Beastmasters); 7220 about the Prethoryn follows 30 days later if in contact.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

7210 “重力陷阱”：科学舰现在能发射重力陷阱，非致命地捕获并运回生态园的太空生物；唯一选项“很好”。
7210: science ships can now launch Gravity Snares to capture space fauna alive for the Vivarium.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 无分支；每次发射陷阱后的冷却、经验奖励由隐藏事件 100 / 115 / 120 处理。 No branches; cooldown and experience are handled by hidden 100/115/120.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 7220（逐星虫无法被捕获）属于另一故事。 7220 belongs to the Prethoryn story.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：events/grand_archive_events.txt, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt
- 已核对 Checked：105、7210、7220 的触发，以及 100-120 的捕获机制。
